facts.fact: 夜班护士 Seine Plenty Wolf 潜入靠呼吸机维生的「死男孩」Sebby Spear Woman 的病房偷东西，她偷走的第一件东西是一只串珠 parfleche（串珠皮袋），横挎着背带带出病房。
facts.anchor: The first thing she spirited away from his room, wearing the strap right across her chest, was a beaded parfleche.

facts.fact: 车祸发生在四个月前，它终将杀死、其实已经杀死了 Nate 走廊尽头的朋友；活下来的这位是 Yellow Tail 家的人，Seine 第一次离开保留地之前就认识那家人——他们总能从该死之事中微笑着走开。
facts.anchor: It had been four months since the wreck that would eventually kill his friend down the hall—that, really, already had—but this one was a Yellow Tail, and Seine remembered that family from before she left the reservation the first time, how they were always walking away from things that should have killed them, walking away smiling that smile of theirs like they were charmed and knew it.

facts.fact: Nate 的叔叔为支付 Nate 父亲 Victor Yellow Tail 的守灵和葬礼，在 Nate 从胰腺和脾脏被击碎的昏迷中醒来之前，把他父亲那辆车卖到了保留地之外。
facts.anchor: Nate’s uncle, to pay for Victor Yellow Tail’s wake and the funeral, had sold the car off the reservation before Nate woke up from having his pancreas and spleen blasted through.

facts.fact: Nate 供出车祸内情：几只只有八英寸高的小鹿走进路中央，他们因此停了车——「就在那之前……你知道的」，随后就出了车祸。
facts.anchor: “They just—they walked out into the road right in front of us,” he went on, holding his hand eight inches off the concrete to show how little he meant. “They’re why we stopped up there. Right before… you know.”

facts.fact: Seine 向 Nate 摊牌：她读了他和 Spear Woman 偷来的那个笔记本，而且读了两遍。
facts.anchor: “That notebook you and Spear Woman stole,” she said, watching out the window but clocking his reflection in the glass too. “I read it. Twice.”

facts.fact: Seine 转述小屋主人 Benjamin Heavy Runner 跑出的家谱：1879 年，Chief Heavy Runner 的儿子在父亲被士兵杀害九年后流落到后来的南达科他州，被「抓人者」带走去了寄宿学校；他当时九岁，死在那里、埋葬在离族人千里之外，直到现在才被想起。
facts.anchor: “What I’m saying is that, in 1879, nine years after his dad was murdered by the soldiers, this Heavy Runner boy was down in what would become South Dakota,” Seine said, trying to keep the forcefulness and urgency out of her voice—she didn’t want to bully him into this, wanted him to step over into it himself. “He was there when one of those catchers came through, getting Indian kids to take them off to residential school.” Seine paused, her head lowered in honor, then added, “He was nine. Nine years old. And… and he died there, thousands of miles from his people. From his home. Then he was buried there, forgotten. Until now, Yellow Tail.”

facts.fact: 小屋主人 Benjamin Heavy Runner 与他的妻子和两个女儿二月来此地雪鞋行走时死于车祸，因此再没有人会追究 Nate 和 Sebby 偷窃小屋的事。
facts.anchor: “Didn’t have to,” Seine said, not grinning back. “Benjamin Heavy Runner and his wife and their two daughters were coming up here in February to snowshoe or something and their car did… you know, that thing Indians’ cars all do? That your dad’s Inpala never did?”

facts.fact: Seine 邀请 Nate 加入把 Heavy Runner 男孩骸骨带回家的「神圣任务」：她已拉到两个同伴、加上自己还缺一人——「我们需要第四个人，四是神圣的」。
facts.anchor: “Thing is, we need a fourth,” Seine said, looking over to the door. “I’ve already got two, plus me, but four’s sacred, you’re Indian enough to know that. And this is a sacred mission.”
